description: Stage 2 of the jabberwock's own curriculum (docs/jabberwock_game_play_design.md): 'the boundary is destruction', UNDERSTOOD. Builds on Stage 1's action_delta. Per its design's termination_prior: roll the controlled-Region model FORWARD one step under each action (cy + action_delta); a predicted next state with NO MODELLED CONTINUATION — off the segmented world — predicts TERMINATION of the Region all the agent's agency depends on. The agent avoids it not by dying and learning a handler, but because the forward rollout predicts no surviving trajectory there (it knows WITHOUT dying). Action selection scores each action and picks the max via competitive-inhibition (Argmax): a predicted-terminating action is catastrophic (huge negative), so it is never chosen while any safe action exists. Death falls with NO death handler. (Surprise can still refine this prior — in a wrap-around world the edge would be observed passable and fold in; that is Stage 4+.)

microtheory.name: stage2_boundary
microtheory.description: roll the model forward; a move off the world = no continuation = termination; choose the safe action; the boundary is understood as destruction, no death handler.

rules.name: roll_forward
rules.comment: The forward rollout (1-step) of the controlled Region under each action: predicted next centroid = its centroid + that action's learned action_delta. Only for the controlled region (respond_votes>=2) and the interaction affordances.

rules.name: mark_terminates
rules.comment: TERMINATION PRIOR: a rolled-forward state OFF the segmented world (the block's centroid past any edge, given the world's observed extent game.h/game.w) has no modelled continuation -> predict termination. terminates=1. This is the prior 'beyond the world there is no next-state defined', applied to the rollout — known without dying.

rules.name: choose_safe_action
rules.comment: Action selection = roll forward, score, pick the max (competitive_inhibition via Argmax over the action affordances). score = directional-gate * (safe*1000 + momentum*100 + idx) − terminates*100000. A predicted-terminating action is CATASTROPHE (−100000): never chosen while any safe action exists. Among safe directionals, momentum (continue the heading) is preferred, so the agent moves coherently and turns only at a boundary it predicts would destroy it. chosen_action = the winning affordance's name (Attr of the Argmax result). No goals yet (Stage 3) — here the only drive is to keep existing.
